title: Guaranteed scholarship processing fee
messageSample: Congratulations dear applicant. You have been selected for a full scholarship. Pay the $180 processing fee today by mobile money to secure your visa support letter.
crossBorderAdaptation: Combines scholarship and visa language to exploit unfamiliarity with U.S. admissions timelines.
safeResponse: Do not pay. Verify award status through the university scholarship portal or official financial aid office domain.

title: Fake embassy appointment cancellation threat
messageSample: IRCC notice: Your study permit appointment will be cancelled in 2 hours unless you confirm passport details and pay biometrics penalty fee via this link.
crossBorderAdaptation: Uses real biometrics terminology to appear credible to first-time study permit applicants.
safeResponse: Log into the official immigration account directly and contact the visa application center through official channels.

title: University admission deposit to personal account
messageSample: Dear student, your CAS is ready. Transfer £900 to our regional finance officer to release your unconditional admission confirmation.
crossBorderAdaptation: References CAS, a real UK study process, to pressure students before they understand official university payment portals.
safeResponse: Pay deposits only through the university portal reached from the official website. Call admissions using the published number.

title: Fake housing deposit before arrival
messageSample: Student room near campus available. Many applicants waiting. Send passport photo and 2 weeks deposit by crypto now; inspection after arrival.
crossBorderAdaptation: Targets students who cannot inspect housing before crossing borders.
safeResponse: Use official university housing resources, request video verification, and avoid irreversible payments to unknown parties.

title: IELTS result upgrade offer
messageSample: Official IELTS insider can upgrade your band score before release. Send candidate number, passport page, and $250 USDT.
crossBorderAdaptation: Exploits language-test pressure in admissions and visa timelines.
safeResponse: Report the account to the platform and use only official test-provider portals for scores.

title: Fake SEVIS fee refund link
messageSample: Aviso SEVIS: usted califica para reembolso. Ingrese datos bancarios y pasaporte en el portal antes de medianoche.
crossBorderAdaptation: Uses Spanish-language visa terminology for families managing U.S. study costs.
safeResponse: Navigate manually to the official government payment site and ask the school international office before entering data.

title: Document legalization courier scam
messageSample: Service officiel d'attestation universitaire. Envoyez scans du passeport, diplôme et 120€ par Western Union pour légalisation rapide.
crossBorderAdaptation: Exploits unfamiliar foreign document legalization steps and parent involvement.
safeResponse: Check embassy and university instructions; avoid sending document scans through social media.

title: Fake campus job onboarding check
messageSample: Remote assistant role approved by international office. Deposit this check, buy gift cards for equipment, keep $300 bonus.
crossBorderAdaptation: Targets students seeking work authorization-safe campus jobs.
safeResponse: Verify jobs through the official career portal and international office before depositing checks or buying items.

title: Admissions portal password reset phishing
messageSample: Your application portal access expires today. Confirm email password and date of birth at university-admissions-secure.com.
crossBorderAdaptation: Exploits multiple application portals and confusion about official domains.
safeResponse: Open the admissions portal from the university website and reset passwords only through official pages.

title: Agent guarantees admission and visa
messageSample: British university direct agent. 100% admission and visa approval. Send transcripts, passport, and first-year tuition to reserve seat.
crossBorderAdaptation: Leverages dependence on local agents for foreign admissions and visa steps.
safeResponse: Confirm agent authorization with the university and pay tuition only to official university accounts.
